value: CORRECTION TO claim.flip-ranking-table-and-corrected-own-pool-screen.20260831.v1's CENTRAL CONCLUSION. That record's ranking method is sound and its own-pool screen is confirmed, but its closing judgement - that the flip frontier is 'BLOCKED BEHIND FIVE HARD STRUCTURAL RESIDUALS, not behind ranking ignorance', every one 're-classified STRUCTURAL after the regnorm/label-correction wave' - does not survive a direct read of the five stragglers' measured signatures. TWO SEPARATE DEFECTS, both measured this pass. (1) THE STRUCTURAL LABEL IS WRONG ON AT LEAST THREE OF THE FIVE. Read read-only with fndiff --ops: G3DReadControlPadStates' entire gap is target-only '+2 addi +1 mr' vs ours-only '-3 li' - three sites of the live-zero copy-vs-remat family and nothing else, i.e. REGISTER_ONLY, and its v1 cap's other stated half (a relocation-identity difference on the gPadManager lis/addi) has ROTTED AWAY ENTIRELY and no longer appears in the diff. dcsHandleRequest's entire opcode gap is ONE instruction of the same family (target-only +1 li vs ours-only -1 addi), with regnorm giving 493 paired / 66 renaming / 2 STRUCTURAL / 2 unpaired, the 66 being a pure 3-cycle formal recolor and the 2 STRUCTURAL being jump-table symbol-name normalization, not payload. fn_800C03E0's gap is likewise dominated by five li-vs-copy clusters in BOTH directions inside one function, plus two more of the same family generalized to a live index (target slwi from a zero-valued register where we constant-fold to li). (2) THE OTHER TWO ARE NOT THE SAME PROBLEM AT ALL AND TWO ARE CHEAPER THAN THE RECORD IMPLIES. WPitchMat3 (43 insns): the whole multiset gap is target-only '+1 lfsu' vs ours-only '-1 lfs' at 0x6c - ONE instruction of the documented load-with-update fusion family that claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention and claim.law.scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form both supply counter-forms for, not a hard structural wall. DoPolyInst (32 insns): target-only '+1 b +1 bge' vs ours-only '-1 beq -1 ble' at 0x20-0x28 - this is exactly the forward unfused conditional-over-unconditional branch pair whose source spelling was NAMED for the first time by claim.law.ternary-diamond-reaches-forward-branch-pair-at-cost-of-temp-result-register.20260831.v1 (arm-swapped ternary with the empty arm first), a law that POSTDATES DoPolyInst's v4 park and whose 'three post-inverted-guard shapes already tried' therefore did not include it. BTriLineCol (450 insns) and GetAnimAngXYZVal (1047 insns) both report opcode multiset IDENTICAL - pure reorder/recolor, schedule-class, count-exact. CONSEQUENCE FOR PLANNING, which is the point of this record. The frontier is not five independent structural walls; it is ONE dominant allocator family (live-zero / live-constant copy-vs-remat, already ruled source-unreachable and do-not-retry) plus TWO genuinely cheap, law-matched candidates that no session has retried since the law that names them was written. The next flip should be attempted on DoPolyInst with the arm-swapped ternary and on WPitchMat3 with the lfsu counter-forms, by a lane that owns those TUs - NOT on further source-shape matrices against the live-zero family, which this lane added three more dead axes to (switch-statement reconstruction of a branch chain, K&R old-style parameter declaration, and a target-backed register-divisor form that restores a divwu at the cost of one li). Note also for volume accounting: the live-zero family now has at least fifteen recorded functions, and its WebFrank candidacy remains blocked because gdlmem tool webfrank's binding constraints forbid structural/immediate rules and the substitution changes instruction FORM (li rD,0 -> addi rD,rS,0 / mr rD,rS), which is a dataflow-equivalence obligation needing a new audit class rather than the existing copy_register_fields guards.
